images.alt:
Indiana Pacers OVER 44.5 - SUPER PICK 
Tyrese Haliburton, the King of the 2025 NBA Playoffs, is back. And with him, hope for the Indiana Pacers to return to glory. The Pacers nearly double-dipped in their gap year, trading a top-4 protected pick to the Clippers for Ivica Zubac, the kind of bruising center they lacked when they won the East and nearly won the 2025 NBA Championship. But the Pacers had to settle for a single dip as the pick slipped to No. 5, losing it to the Clippers, despite having the 2nd worst record in the league.

quote.author: Shams Charania Tweets
quote.text: Minnesota Timberwolves All-Defense forward Jaden McDaniels has agreed to a one-year, $40 million extension that will keep him under contract through the 2029-30 season, agents Nima Namakian of Innovate Sports and Bill Duffy of WME Basketball tell ESPN.
